newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Oct cumulative PSBR falls.
newsitem.headline: Italy Oct cumulative PSBR falls.

text.p: Italy's cumulative public sector borrowing requirement was 116.38 trillion lire at end-October 1996 compared with 116.95 trillion in end October 1995, the Treasury Ministry said in a statement.
Receipts totalled 409.87 trillion lire over the period against expenditure of 548.46 trillion, but this gap was partially covered by a net surplus on Treasury management operations of 22.19 trillion.
Medium- and long-term domestic borrowing over the period raised 98.78 trillion, while 9.37 trillion was raised on international markets.
The volume of short-term Treasury bills in circulation fell 17.2 trillion lire to 394.81 trillion at end-October from 412.014 trillion at end-December 1995.
